Lemma
[Radial Objects Are Intrinsic] ↗ prop:uniqueness-normal-coordinates 1. ch6:6.8

The radial distance $r$ and radial vector field $\partial _r$ are independent of the normal coordinates. Both are smooth on $U\setminus \{ p\} $, and $r^2$ is smooth on $U$.

Proof

\sketch Normal-coordinate transitions have the form $\widetilde x^i=A^i_jx^j$ with $A\in O(n)$. Formulas (6.4) and (6.5) are invariant under these transitions, and their smoothness statements follow from the same formulas.

□
